lines: Built with: no bundler config in /app.
No package.json and no bundler config, so the 108 files in build (55,722 B) are taken as written by hand and delivered as they are.
Source maps, module format and how a page is split are properties of a build, so no finding about them is made.
No src directory in /app, so no finding about how this app imports anything could be made. --src=DIR names the source directory.
